en: 2 Timothy 4
ja: テモテへの第二の手紙 4

p.src: 1  I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

ja: と、また、その現れと御国の時に
en: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:
u.src: 1  I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

p.src: 2  preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

ja: くても、たゆまず務めなさい。あらゆる
えを尽くして、誤りを指摘し、
en: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.
u.src: 2  preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

p.src: 3  For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

ja: えに耳を傾けなくなる
en: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,
u.src: 3  For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

p.src: 4  and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

en: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.
u.src: 4  and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

p.src: 5  But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

ja: しかしあなたは、どんな場合にも冷静さを保ち、
en: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.
u.src: 5  But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

p.src: 6  For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

ja: とされつつあり、旅立つ
en: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
u.src: 6  For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

p.src: 7  I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

en: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
u.src: 7  I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

p.src: 8  From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

ja: のために蓄えられています。
れを愛してきたすべての
en: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
u.src: 8  From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

p.src: 9  Be diligent to come to me soon,

en: Be diligent to come to me soon,
u.src: 9  Be diligent to come to me soon,

p.src: 10  for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

ja: きました。クレスケンスはガラテヤへ、テトスはダルマティアへ
en: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.
u.src: 10  for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

p.src: 11  Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

ja: 私と一緒にいるのはルカだけです。マルコを
en: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.
u.src: 11  Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

p.src: 12  But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

en: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
u.src: 12  But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

p.src: 13  Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

ja: がトロアスのカルポの所に置いてきた
てください。書物も、特に羊皮紙も持って来てください。
en: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.
u.src: 13  Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

p.src: 14  Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

en: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
u.src: 14  Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

p.src: 15  Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

ja: しく逆らったからです。
en: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.
u.src: 15  Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

p.src: 16  At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

ja: てました。どうか、それが
らの罪とされませんように。
en: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
u.src: 16  At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

p.src: 17  But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

ja: めてくださいました。それは、
を通して福音の知らせが余すところなく告げられ、すべての
くためでした。こうして
en: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
u.src: 17  But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

p.src: 18  And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

ja: ってくださいます。主に
りなくありますように。アーメン。
en: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
u.src: 18  And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

p.src: 19  Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

ja: プリスカとアキラ、そしてオネシフォロの
en: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
u.src: 19  Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

p.src: 20  Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

ja: エラストはコリントに残りました。トロフィモは
en: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.
u.src: 20  Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

p.src: 21  Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

ja: いでください。エウブロ、プデス、リノス、クラウディア、そしてすべての
たちが、あなたによろしくと
en: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
u.src: 21  Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

p.src: 22  The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

ja: イエス・キリストがあなたの
にありますように。アーメン。
en: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
u.src: 22  The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
